elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: The inserted warranty covers only conformance of the SFJ Services "in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement" for 30 days; no professional/workmanlike or industry-standards limb was added, and Section 13.5 warrants only sufficiency of funds.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: New clause (b): "any software provided by SFJ under this Agreement will conform to its documentation for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery."

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software limb runs ninety (90) days following delivery, not twelve (12) months.
The SFJ Services limb runs thirty (30) days following performance, not ninety (90) days.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "SFJ will, at its option, re-perform, repair or replace the non-conforming SFJ Services or software."
"...or refund to PB the amounts paid for them."

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No compliance-with-laws warranty appears in the inserted clause or in Section 13.5 (funding covenant only).

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No malicious-code warranty was inserted; the rendered Article 13 text contains no such representation.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Express software-to-documentation warranty: "any software provided by SFJ under this Agreement will conform to its documentation for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery." The conditional framing (if SFJ provides software) does not shorten or qualify the 90-day period; the warranty operates whenever software is in fact provided.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: "for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the SFJ Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement" \u2014 SFJ Services is a defined term (Section 1.1.169) and the period equals the 30-day floor.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: "SFJ will, at its option, re-perform, repair or replace the non-conforming SFJ Services or software."
"...or refund to PB the amounts paid for them" \u2014 refund is an express alternative remedy.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: 90-day software-to-documentation warranty, 30-day SFJ Services conformance warranty, and repair/replacement plus refund remedies all appear in operative language, so the finding is position-complete at the fallback level and no redline beyond this is required.

Preferred level is not reached: the professional-and-workmanlike standard, 12-month software period, 90-day services period, compliance-with-laws warranty and no-malicious-code warranty are all absent. These are noted as short of preferred, not as further deviations.

Placement is correct and effective: the new warranty sits inside Article 13, so the Section 13.6.2 disclaimer's "EXCEPT AS OTHERWISE SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE 13" carve-out preserves it rather than swallowing it. Recommend confirming the clause is numbered (e.g., 13.5.1) in the executed draft, as the rendered heading "SFJ Services Warranty" carries no section number.

Minimal: nothing is deleted, no favourable existing language (including the Section 13.5 funding covenant) is disturbed, and the insertion adds no survival tail, at-own-expense language, notice procedure, cure mechanic or extra damages category. "Re-perform" tracks the playbook model remedy language for services and is not an out-of-scope extra.

Preserves intent: the clause uses the existing defined term "SFJ Services" (Section 1.1.169), creates no dangling cross-reference or undefined term, and does not contradict any retained sentence \u2014 the conditional software limb is a factual contingency, not an undefined trigger.

Optional (non-blocking) improvement toward the preferred position if negotiation room exists: add "in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards" to limb (a) and extend the software period to twelve (12) months.
